title: Meeting consent
description: Whether participants are told a meeting is recorded, and whether their consent is needed first.
appliesText: A saved change applies to meetings whose consent starts after the save; a meeting already under way keeps the mode and rule it started with.

mode.title: Consent mode
mode.description: Off: no notice. Notify: record unless someone objects. Opt-in: record nothing until consent is given.

consentRule.title: Consent rule (opt-in)
consentRule.description: Each participant: everyone present must consent. Owner attests: the owner confirms everyone agreed.

enumLabels.owner_attests: The meeting owner attests that everyone agreed

notifyNoticeText.title: Notice text (notify)
notifyNoticeText.description: Posted when a Notify meeting starts. Placeholders: {LMA_USER}, {meeting}, {consent_phrase}, {objection_phrase}.

optInNoticeText.title: Consent request text (opt-in)
optInNoticeText.description: Posted when an Opt-in meeting starts. Same placeholders as the Notify notice.

videoNoticeText.title: Video sentence
videoNoticeText.description: Added to the notice whenever the meeting's video is recorded. No placeholders.

consentPhrases.title: Consent phrases
consentPhrases.description: Comma-separated phrases read as consent in a reply (whole words, any case).

objectionPhrases.title: Objection phrases
objectionPhrases.description: Comma-separated phrases read as an objection. Checked before consent phrases.

allowPerMeetingOverride.title: Allow a different choice per meeting
allowPerMeetingOverride.description: On: a meeting may use another mode or rule. Off: only this one or a stricter one.

keepEvidenceScreenshots.title: Keep evidence screenshots
keepEvidenceScreenshots.description: On: keep consent evidence screenshots with the meeting. Off: delete each once it has been checked.

verifierModelId.title: Evidence check model
verifierModelId.description: The Amazon Bedrock vision model that checks consent evidence screenshots. Image-capable models only.

clientsWithoutConsent.title: Streaming clients without a consent step
clientsWithoutConsent.description: What to do with a streaming client that has no consent step: accept with a warning, or refuse to record.

enumLabels.accept_with_warning: Accept with a warning (no consent record)

leaveOnObjection.title: Virtual Participant leaves after an objection
leaveOnObjection.description: On: the Virtual Participant leaves when someone objects. Off: it stops recording and stays.

readSpokenReplies.title: Read spoken replies
readSpokenReplies.description: Also hear spoken consent replies. Sends meeting audio to the transcription engine while consent is awaited.

advanceConsentEnabled.title: Allow consent given in advance
advanceConsentEnabled.description: Let people consent before a meeting, by link or on the My consents page.

advanceConsentMaxDays.title: Longest consent given in advance, in days
advanceConsentMaxDays.description: The longest an advance consent can last, in days (1 to 365).

advanceConsentText.title: Consent text (given in advance)
advanceConsentText.description: What a person agrees to when consenting in advance. Placeholders: {organizer}, {meeting}, {scope}.

keepAdvanceConsentDeviceDetails.title: Keep sign-in device details with consents given in advance
keepAdvanceConsentDeviceDetails.description: Also store the IP address and browser of advance consents. The IP address is personal data.
